records.title: Odysseus landing location
records.fact: NASA LRO analysis places the IM-1 Odysseus lander at 80.13 degrees south, 1.44 degrees east near Malapert A. NASA reports an elevation of minus 2,579 metres relative to the lunar mean radius and a local slope of 12 degrees.

records.title: IM-1 surface science
records.fact: NASA reports that Odysseus landed on 22 February 2024, operated for seven days, returned more than 500 megabytes of data, and all six NASA payloads met some level of their objectives.

records.title: Blue Ghost Mission 1 landing
records.fact: NASA reports that Firefly Aerospace's Blue Ghost landed near Mons Latreille in Mare Crisium on 2 March 2025 at 3:34 a.m. EST carrying ten NASA science and technology instruments.

records.title: IM-2 Athena landing
records.fact: NASA reports that Intuitive Machines' Athena lander touched down near the lunar south pole on 6 March 2025. The reviewed NASA source does not establish a precise coordinate, so this application does not place an exact marker.

records.title: Peregrine Mission One conclusion
records.fact: Peregrine Mission One did not land on the Moon. NASA reports that the spacecraft safely re-entered Earth's atmosphere over the South Pacific on 18 January 2024, so no lunar landing marker is shown.
